scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Hello? I'm Artisan Tene, the most respectful blacksmith of them all.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
你好？我是工匠泰內，最受人尊敬的鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Which blacksmith?
scripts.translation: 哪位鐵匠？

scripts.text: I want to add option.
scripts.translation: 我想新增選項

scripts.text: I want to remove option.
scripts.translation: 我想移除選項

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! Sorry, I didn't introduce myself.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
啊！抱歉，我還沒自我介紹。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I can add or remove options from some weapons and armor at a small price.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
我可以以低廉的價格為部分武器和防具新增或移除選項。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! Do you want to know the list of weapons and armor I work on?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
啊！您想知道我能處理的武器和防具列表嗎？

scripts.text: Take a look at the weapon list.
scripts.translation: 檢視武器列表

scripts.text: Take a look at the armor list.
scripts.translation: 檢視防具列表

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Are you interested in the weapon list?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您對武器列表感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The weapons I work on are 
^ff0000Raksasa Dagger [1]^000000
^ff0000Mikatsuki[1]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Swirling Petal [2]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Fluttering Snow^000000
^ff0000Huuma Thunderstorm^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
我能處理的武器是
^ff0000羅釵短劍 [1]^000000
^ff0000三日月[1]^000000
^ff0000風魔手裡劍亂華 [2]^000000
^ff0000風魔手裡劍亂雪^000000
^ff0000風魔手裡劍雷雨^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Are you interested in the armor list?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您對防具列表感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The armor I work on is
^ff0000Wolf Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Crescent Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Ninja Scale Armor [1]^000000
^ff0000Tenebris Latitantes [1]^000000
^ff0000Special Ninja Suit [1]^000000

[Artisan Tene]
This is it. I'm still in practice to learn and handle more battlegear.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
就是這些了。我還在練習，以便學習並處理更多的戰鬥裝備。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
If you'd like, I can add options to your 4th and 3rd Slots at a small cost.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
如果您願意，我可以以低廉的費用為您裝備的第4和第3槽位新增選項。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! You need to add an option.
I use the method of adding options to your 4th and 3rd slots of battlegear equipped.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
啊！您需要新增選項。
我使用的方法是為已裝備的戰鬥裝備的第4和第3槽位新增選項。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Since I use a stable and unique way of adding options, there are no risks of ^ff0000'Reset Refine'^000000 or ^ff0000'Losing Cards'^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
由於我使用穩定且獨特的方式新增選項，因此不存在^ff0000'重置強化'^000000或^ff0000'丟失卡片'^000000的風險。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
But since the costs of materials are high, I only ask for a ^5565AA small cost^000000 for my services with the exception of the material expenses.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
但由於材料成本較高，除了材料費用外，我只收取^5565AA少量費用^000000作為我的服務費。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Ha ha. I must have talked too much. Which class of equipment do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
哈哈。我可能說得太多了。您想為哪類裝備新增選項？

scripts.text: Weapon...
scripts.translation: 武器...

scripts.text: Armor...
scripts.translation: 防具...

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
So you want to add an option to your weapon. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想為武器新增選項。單次服務費用為^ff0000100,000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^FF0000Ah! I can add an additional option if you equip a one-handed weapon on your right hand because it is easier for me to work on.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
^FF0000啊！如果您在右手裝備單手武器，我可以額外新增一個選項，因為這樣我操作起來更方便。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Which weapon do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想為哪件武器新增選項？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍後...

scripts.text: Raksasa Dagger [1]
scripts.translation: 羅釵短劍 [1]

scripts.text: Mikatsuki [1]
scripts.translation: 三日月 [1]

scripts.text: Huuma Swirling Petal [2]
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍亂華 [2]

scripts.text: Huuma Fluttering Snow
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍亂雪

scripts.text: Huuma Thunderstorm
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍雷雨

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
改變主意了？好吧。期待下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
So you want to add an option to your armor. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想為防具新增選項。單次服務費用為^ff0000100,000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Which armor do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想為哪件防具新增選項？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍後...

scripts.text: Wolf Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 狼紋護手 [1]

scripts.text: Crescent Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 月紋護手 [1]

scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor [1]
scripts.translation: 忍者鱗甲 [1]

scripts.text: Tenebris Latitantes [1]
scripts.translation: 霧中暗影 [1]

scripts.text: Special Ninja Suit [1]
scripts.translation: 特攻忍裝 [1]

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
改變主意了？好吧。期待下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You want to remove an option from your item. You didn't like the option?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想移除物品上的選項。是不喜歡這個選項嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Sorry but I'm not experienced enough. You've paid me for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
抱歉，我的經驗還不夠。讓您白花錢了。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^ff0000Removing an option will be 100,000 Zeny.^000000 Which option from the list of items do you want to remove?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
^ff0000移除選項的費用是100,000 Zeny。^000000您想移除列表中的哪個選項？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍後...

scripts.text: Raksasa Dagger [1]
scripts.translation: 羅釵短劍 [1]

scripts.text: Mikatsuki [1]
scripts.translation: 三日月 [1]

scripts.text: Huuma Swirling Petal [2]
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍亂華 [2]

scripts.text: Huuma Fluttering Snow
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍亂雪

scripts.text: Huuma Thunderstorm
scripts.translation: 風魔手裡劍雷雨

scripts.text: Wolf Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 狼紋護手 [1]

scripts.text: Crescent Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 月紋護手 [1]

scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor [1]
scripts.translation: 忍者鱗甲 [1]

scripts.text: Tenebris Latitantes [1]
scripts.translation: 霧中暗影 [1]

scripts.text: Special Ninja Suit [1]
scripts.translation: 特攻忍裝 [1]

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Removing options is expensive, isn't it? Sorry. I will work harder in developing my skills and bring down costs as well.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
移除選項的費用很高，對吧？抱歉。我會努力提升技術，並降低費用的。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You want to reset ^44B7BC{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您想要重置 ^44B7BC{0}^000000 嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The cost is the same but I do provide a service to remove only the option on the 3rd slot and leave the 4th slot as is. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
費用是一樣的，但我提供只移除第3個槽位選項、保留第4個槽位的服務。您有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Reset only the 3rd Slot.
scripts.translation: 只重置第3個槽位

scripts.text: Reset all.
scripts.translation: 全部重置

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. I will reset only your 3rd slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
好的。我將只重置您的第3個槽位。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. I will reset all slots.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
好的。我將重置所有槽位。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You will have to equip all items before ^44B7BC{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
您必須在 ^44B7BC{0}^000000 之前裝備好所有物品。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足！

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Our charge is very low, so please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
我們的收費很低，請多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I don't think this is the equipment you requested.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
我認為這不是您要求的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I cannot work on equipment other than those from my list.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
我無法處理列表之外的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The third slot is is not enchanted. Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
第3個槽位沒有附魔。請再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment is is not enchanted. Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
這件裝備沒有附魔。請再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Initialization complete.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
初始化完成。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment cannot be further enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
這件裝備無法繼續附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
If you are not satisfied with the enchantments, I suggest that you initialize.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
如果您對附魔結果不滿意，我建議進行初始化。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The fourth slot has already been enchanted. Shall I enchant the third slot as well?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
第4個槽位已經附魔了。我要把第3個槽位也附魔嗎？

scripts.text: Do it later
scripts.translation: 稍後再做

scripts.text: Do it now
scripts.translation: 現在做

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
好的。期待下次為您服務。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Starting to enchant the third slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
開始對第3個槽位進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment is not currently enchanted. Shall I enchant the fourth slot?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
這件裝備目前還沒有附魔。我要對第4個槽位進行附魔嗎？

scripts.text: Do it later
scripts.translation: 稍後再做

scripts.text: Do it now
scripts.translation: 現在做

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
好的。期待下次為您服務。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Starting to enchant the fourth slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
開始對第4個槽位進行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
An unknown error has occurred. Please contact customer service. *^_^*
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
發生未知錯誤。請聯絡客服。 *^_^*

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^44B7BC{0}^000000
The equipment has been enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰內]
^44B7BC{0}^000000
裝備附魔完成。
